text: Given the Microsoft Graph connector's tool list is refreshed, When a caller lists its tools, Then graph_transfer_onedrive and graph_start_cloud_sync both appear and the total tool count is 41
Given a source user with root items and an existing destination user, When graph_transfer_onedrive is called, Then it returns status=started and every item reports action=copy_started

Given the destination folder already contains every source item at matching name and size, When graph_transfer_onedrive is called again, Then it returns status=completed, every item reports action=already_present, and zero copy calls are issued

Given the destination folder contains some items at a different size than the source, When graph_transfer_onedrive is called again, Then it returns status=in_progress and issues zero copy calls for those items
Given a source user with no OneDrive provisioned, When graph_transfer_onedrive is called, Then it returns a drive_not_found error naming the source and makes no call for the destination
Given a source user whose OneDrive root is empty, When graph_transfer_onedrive is called, Then it returns status=no_content and creates no destination folder
Given a destination user with no OneDrive provisioned, When graph_transfer_onedrive is called, Then it returns a drive_not_found error naming the destination and makes no change to the source

Given a synced user (onPremisesSyncEnabled=true) and exactly one discoverable cloud-sync job, When graph_start_cloud_sync is called, Then it returns status=started with the resolved job_id and service_principal_id
Given a cloud-only user (onPremisesSyncEnabled=false), When graph_start_cloud_sync is called, Then it returns status=not_applicable and issues no /start call

Given a tenant with zero discoverable cloud-sync jobs, When graph_start_cloud_sync is called for a synced user, Then it returns no_sync_job_configured naming the on-prem Start-ADSyncSyncCycle alternative
Given a tenant with two discoverable cloud-sync jobs, When graph_start_cloud_sync is called, Then it returns sync_job_ambiguous listing both candidate job ids

Given two graph_start_cloud_sync calls made with two different fake clients standing in for two different tenants' tokens, When each call's service-principal/job discovery runs, Then neither call's resolved ids appear in the other call's request trace (no cross-tenant caching)

Given an INT tenant with Azure AD Connect cloud sync actually configured and a real offboarding test user with OneDrive content, When both tools are run end-to-end against it, Then graph_transfer_onedrive's copy is observed to complete and graph_start_cloud_sync's job is observed to run
steps: Obtain or confirm an INT tenant with Azure AD Connect cloud sync configured and admin consent granted for Synchronization.ReadWrite.All and Files.ReadWrite.All
Identify a disposable source test user with a few files in OneDrive root, and a destination test user
Call graph_transfer_onedrive(source, destination); wait; call it again to observe status transition from started/in_progress to completed
Call graph_start_cloud_sync(user_id=source) and observe the returned job_id; separately confirm (via the tenant's own sync status, outside this MCP) that a run was actually triggered
expect: graph_transfer_onedrive eventually reports status=completed with the destination folder containing all source root items at matching size; graph_start_cloud_sync reports status=started and the tenant's own sync history shows a run starting at or after the call
